usageNotice.title: Usage Notes
usageNotice.heroTitle: Check what your plan can do first
usageNotice.heroDesc: Lens unlocks academic capabilities across Plus, Pro, and Max. While your membership is active, you can use the capabilities included in your plan. Each task still consumes points based on the selected model and task type.
usageNotice.plusAvailable1: Paper summary, Arxiv summary, Arxiv English summary
usageNotice.plusAvailable2: Chinese polish, English polish, Chinese-English translation
usageNotice.plusAvailable3: Mind map, code explanation, reference to BibTeX
usageNotice.plusNote: Includes YutoGPT 5.5 and GPT-6 luna, subject to the currently available model list. PDF deep read, PDF batch summary, Word batch summary, and advanced LaTeX tools are not included.
usageNotice.proSummary: Frequent paper reading and manuscript work
usageNotice.proAvailable2: PDF deep read, PDF batch summary, Word batch summary
usageNotice.proAvailable3: LaTeX summary, precise translation, English polish, Chinese polish, and highlight correction
usageNotice.proNote: Adds GPT-6.1 Sol to the Plus models, subject to the currently available model list. Best for regular workflows such as “PDF deep read → English polish”.
usageNotice.maxAvailable2: Access to all currently available Lens academic capabilities
usageNotice.maxAvailable3: Supports full workflows such as “Paper summary → Chinese polish → Mind map”
usageNotice.maxNote: Adds Claude Opus 5.5 to the Pro models, subject to the currently available model list. Best for long papers, multiple files, and complex research tasks.
usageNotice.billingRule1: Monthly plans and monthly card codes grant the corresponding quota for 30 days.
usageNotice.billingRule2: Annual plans and annual card codes grant 12 months of quota for 365 days.
usageNotice.billingRule3: Standard, advanced, and top-tier points are consumed based on the selected model and task shown by the system.
usageNotice.billingRule4: Membership benefits stop after expiration. Renew or redeem a new member card to continue.
usageNotice.taskRule1: Workflow pipelines run sequentially. The next step starts only after the previous step finishes.
usageNotice.taskRule2: PDF, Word, LaTeX, long papers, and slower upstream models can increase total waiting time.
usageNotice.taskRule3: Do not upload keys, IDs, contracts, customer data, account passwords, or other sensitive content.
usageNotice.taskRule4: AI outputs may be inaccurate. Verify important conclusions, citations, and experiment details before use.

workspace.academicWorkbenchDesc: A workspace for paper reading, academic writing, translation, and research code
workspace.protocolMaterialsDetail: Bring source material into the workspace
workspace.startAcademicWorkDesc: Enter a question on the right, then choose a basic function or plugin.
workspace.inputShortcut: Enter to submit · Shift + Enter for a new line
workspace.inputGuide: Paste a paper excerpt directly, or import PDF, LaTeX, DOCX, and Markdown files.
workspace.pluginFunctionsDesc: Connect multiple steps into a research workflow
workspace.serviceUnavailableDesc: We cannot connect to the research service right now. Please try again later.
workspace.stepAddDataDesc: Upload papers, LaTeX, code, or experiment materials.
workspace.stepInputTaskDesc: State whether you want a summary, translation, polish, or method breakdown.
workspace.stepFollowUpDesc: Keep iterating on the result, compare outputs, or export the conclusion.
workspace.starterResearchPlanDesc: Plan methods, sampling, validation, and milestones.
workspace.starterResearchPlanPrompt: Design an actionable research plan based on my research question and available materials. If information is missing, first ask about objectives, available data, time, and resources. Specify methods, sample or material selection, analysis steps, validation criteria, risks, and milestones. Distinguish recommendations from confirmed facts. Do not fabricate data, experimental results, or literature.
workspace.starterDesc: Decide whether you are reading materials, writing content, or running a full workflow.
workspace.starterPaperSummaryDesc: Capture the question, method, and conclusion quickly.
workspace.starterPaperSummaryPrompt: Please summarize this paper's research question, methodology, core conclusions, and key contributions.
workspace.starterPdfDeepReadDesc: Work through the material, experiments, and limits in detail.
workspace.starterPdfDeepReadPrompt: Using this PDF, extract the research question, key methods, experimental results, and the most worthwhile follow-up questions.
workspace.starterEnglishPolishDesc: Rewrite sentences and paragraphs with academic tone intact.
workspace.starterEnglishPolishPrompt: Please polish this English abstract while keeping it academically accurate, concise, and natural.
workspace.starterLatexTranslationDesc: Keep formulas and commands untouched while translating.
workspace.starterLatexTranslationPrompt: Please keep LaTeX formulas and commands unchanged and translate this content into Chinese.
workspace.starterCodeExplainDesc: Break down inputs, outputs, core logic, and intent.
workspace.starterCodeExplainPrompt: Please explain what this code does, its inputs and outputs, and the key implementation logic.
workspace.starterArxivSummaryDesc: Judge quickly whether a new paper deserves deep reading.
workspace.starterArxivSummaryPrompt: Based on this arXiv paper, summarize the core problem, method path, results, and the best follow-up questions to explore.
workspace.starterMultiPaperCompareDesc: Contrast questions, methods, evidence, and conclusions.
workspace.starterMultiPaperComparePrompt: Compare the papers in the current sources. Create a table covering research questions, theoretical frameworks, methods, data, core findings, limitations, and contradictions, then identify the most valuable research gaps.
workspace.starterQuestionBreakdownDesc: Define scope, hypotheses, and validation methods.
workspace.starterQuestionBreakdownPrompt: Clarify the scope and goal of my research topic or current sources, asking questions first if information is missing. Break it into testable subquestions, hypotheses, variables, required evidence, and feasible methods. Distinguish established facts from unverified judgments. Do not invent data or conclusions.
workspace.starterLiteratureReviewDesc: Map research themes, disagreements, and gaps.
workspace.starterLiteratureReviewPrompt: Build a literature review around my research question using only the literature I have provided. Organize themes, methods, agreements, disagreements, and research gaps, linking each claim to its source. If sources are insufficient, ask for literature or suggest search directions. Do not fabricate literature, citations, quotations, or page numbers.
workspace.starterResearchNotesDesc: Turn sources into traceable evidence and next actions.
workspace.starterResearchNotesPrompt: Organize the current sources into structured research notes. Separate factual evidence, author claims, my inferences, questions to verify, and next actions. Do not fabricate citations.
workspace.starterTeachingMaterialDesc: Build explanations, examples, and exercises around learning goals.
workspace.starterTeachingMaterialPrompt: Create teaching material from the current sources. First establish the learner level and lesson duration, then provide learning objectives, key concepts, a teaching outline, classroom examples, discussion questions, and exercises.
workspace.workflowActiveHint: Your current capability is ready. Add materials or task context to begin.
workspace.workflowSectionDesc: Connect academic capabilities into one traceable research process.
workspace.featureDesignReviewPrompt:
Review alignment of questions, methods, samples, measurements and analysis. List evidence gaps, biases, priorities and minimal improvements. Ask for missing information; never invent data, findings or references.

My research design:
workspace.featureReviewerReplyPrompt:
Use the supplied reviewer comments and manuscript to map concerns to revisions, required evidence and draft replies. Distinguish completed and planned work. Never claim unperformed experiments or revisions are complete or invent evidence.

Reviewer comments and manuscript:
workspace.featureSearchStrategyPrompt:
Plan a reproducible search strategy: concepts, keywords, Boolean queries, databases, inclusion/exclusion criteria and a search log template. Clarify the scope as needed. Do not claim to have searched databases or invent references or counts.

Research topic:
